newsitem.title: USA: Clinton makes golf part of debate preparations.
newsitem.headline: Clinton makes golf part of debate preparations.

text.p: President Clinton Monday said golf was a "great way" to prepare for his upcoming debate with Republican Bob Dole on Wednesday night.
Clinton, who has been preparing for the debate with practice sessions in the morning and evening, spent the afternoon playing golf at Arroyo del Oso Municipal Course in Albuquerque.
"You get beat up in the morning, clear your head in the afternoon, get beat up again at night," a smiling Clinton told reporters. "It's a great way to do it."
